display.purpose: Hero name (Aimee Marcos). Identity layer only — the single largest, most characterful element on the page.

subtitle.purpose: Hero subtitle 'Graphic Designer'. Functional clarification; must remain ≥2.5× smaller than display.

section-heading.purpose: Identity-layer headings: 'capabilities', 'strategic strengths'. Not for toolbox or nav headings.

functional-heading.purpose: Process/tool headings: 'design approach and toolbox'. Organizational, not identity.

body.purpose: Hero tagline, primary reading copy. Max line length 68ch.

body-small.purpose: Lists, capability items, longer descriptive passages.

label.purpose: Nav links, card titles, footer text, toolbox row descriptions.

label-micro.purpose: Card category strings and section marks (01 / work). Sole uppercase usage in the system.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Default easing for all transitions involving movement. Used on card hover scale and hero animation.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Secondary easing for simpler state transitions (cover image zoom, nav toggle spans).

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Nav becomes fixed + hamburger; grid collapses to single column; type scale reduces

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: Work grid collapses from 3-col to 2-col + stacked wide card

components.name: Work Card
components.description: Image-first portfolio card. The photograph is the whole card; metadata overlays as a gradient label at the base.
components.html: Branding · Visual Identity Marginalia
components.css: .ds-work-card { display: block; position: relative; border: 1px solid oklch(8% 0.008 40); border-radius: 6px; background: oklch(91% 0.007 75); overflow: hidden; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; aspect-ratio: 587 / 189; transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-work-card:hover { transform: scale(1.015); } .ds-work-card__cover { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; transition: transform 0.35s ease; } .ds-work-card:hover .ds-work-card__cover { transform: scale(1.04); } .ds-work-card__label { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; padding: 24px 16px 16px; background: linear-gradient(to top, oklch(8% 0.008 40 / 0.6) 0%, transparent 100%); color: oklch(97% 0.008 80); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; } .ds-work-card__category { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: 0.75; } .ds-work-card__title { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Minimal navigation anchor. Opacity fade on hover; 2px ink outline on focus-visible.
components.html: Work About Contact
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 32px; } .ds-nav-link { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(8% 0.008 40); text-decoration: none; transition: opacity 0.2s; } .ds-nav-link:hover { opacity: 0.6; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(8% 0.008 40); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Footer
components.description: Border-top divider with credit text left and LinkedIn icon right. Opacity hover on the social link.
components.css: .ds-footer { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 24px 120px; border-top: 1px solid oklch(8% 0.008 40); margin-top: 64px; } .ds-footer__credit { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(8% 0.008 40); } .ds-footer__social { color: oklch(8% 0.008 40); display: inline-flex; transition: opacity 0.2s; } .ds-footer__social:hover { opacity: 0.6; } .ds-footer__social:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(8% 0.008 40); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-footer__icon { width: 20px; height: 20px; }

components.css: .ds-hero { padding: 0 120px; margin-top: 64px; margin-bottom: 100px; } .ds-hero__h1 { display: flex; flex-direction: column; font-size: 46px; line-height: 1.2; margin-bottom: 24px; } .ds-hero__name { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; color: oklch(8% 0.008 40); } .ds-hero__title { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(8% 0.008 40); } .ds-hero__tagline { font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 400; line-height: 1.4; max-width: 679px; color: oklch(8% 0.008 40); }

narrative.overview:
This portfolio thinks in spreads, not screens. The design logic is borrowed from editorial print: generous white space, a single typeface held to strict weight contrast, borders drawn in one color only. Aimee's work — full-color, conceptually dense, genre-spanning — needs a neutral to land against. The portfolio IS that neutral. It has no aesthetic agenda of its own; it creates the conditions for the work to be seen.

The personality is warm professional: rigorous enough to signal craft, restrained enough to stay out of the work's way. Nothing performs. The typewriter hero names the person. Everything after is curation.
keyCharacteristics: Single typeface (Inter), three weights, strict scale
Ink-only palette — no accent, no tint, no gradient on type
8px card grid creates visual compression; 120px page margins create air
Borders as the only structural signal — no shadow, no blur, no surface lifting
Motion is earned: the typewriter intro has permission; scroll animations have a low bar; decoration has none

rules.name: The Editorial Monochrome Rule
rules.body: There is no accent color. Introducing any tint breaks the neutrality that makes work images read. If a design reach for a color, ask what it adds that the work doesn't already supply. The answer is almost always: nothing.

rules.name: The Scrim Exception
rules.body: The one permitted gradient is the card label overlay: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(0,0,0,0.6), transparent). It is functional (legibility), not decorative. It does not set a precedent for gradients elsewhere.

rules.name: The Weight Ladder Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy is built through size and weight contrast only — never color, never decoration. Each step down the type scale must be visually distinct without relying on anything but scale ratio (≥1.25) and weight shift (400 → 500 → 700).

rules.name: The Uppercase Micro Rule
rules.body: text-transform: uppercase is permitted only at Label-micro (10px card categories). At any larger size, uppercase text fights the editorial register. Prohibited in headings, nav, body, and button labels.

dos: Do let work images be the dominant element on every screen. The UI is the frame; the work is the art.
Do use generous page margins (120px desktop) as a first response to 'this feels crowded.'
Do use cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) easing for all transitions involving movement.
Do follow focus-visible with outline: 2px solid #000000 on every interactive element.
Do use Label-micro (10px / uppercase / 0.08em tracking) only for card category strings.
Do collapse the asymmetric grid gracefully at breakpoints — the editorial composition should survive at every width.
donts: Don't introduce an accent color. The Editorial Monochrome rule stands.
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text with any gradient). Prohibited regardless of context.
Don't use border-left or border-right greater than 1px as a colored stripe on any card, callout, or list item.
Don't add animation that performs rather than communicates. If the motion would be better still, it should be still.
Don't replicate Behance or Dribbble aesthetics — shiny hover effects, drop shadows on every card, gradient overlays as style.
Don't use scrolljacking, parallax on text, or particle effects.
Don't add cards inside cards, or nest containers that already have padding.
Don't add a dark mode speculatively. A dark variant requires a full design pass, not a CSS variable swap.
